headline: Autoline Industries Limited announces amalgamation of Autoline Design Software Limited
sum: Autoline Industries, an NSE-listed automotive software firm, announced the amalgamation of its subsidiary/associate Autoline Design Software Limited into itself via stock exchange disclosure on 30 Jun 2026. Details of consideration, share swap ratio, and NCLT approval timeline were not disclosed in the filing itself.
detail: Autoline Industries Limited informed the NSE of the proposed amalgamation of Autoline Design Software Limited (ADSL) with itself on 30 June 2026. The filing provides no detail on consideration structure, share issuance, or effective date. In India, all statutory amalgamations require High Court/NCLT sanction under Section 232 of the Companies Act 2013 (unless both are wholly owned subsidiaries, in which case NCLT approval is discretionary). The timing and market context suggest this may be a pre-NCLT announcement or post-approval notification; no corroborating NCLT order or company press release was located.
